annotations.title: Map buyer prompts for AI search

description: Run the AI-prompt-map workflow: research for a list of buyer prompts worth tracking, from AI search, SEO demand, trends, citations, Reddit, and YouTube data. It returns evidence and a suggested prompt, not a finished list; prompts written from it can be tracked with cite42_tracker_create. Billed for the steps that succeed, at per-surface rates. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

brand.description: Optional brand/domain to include in prompt tracking recommendations.

fullSweep.description: Query all five AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) for full cross-surface coverage, at a higher cost. Ignored when models is given.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000.

topic.description: Market, product category, buyer problem, or audience to map prompts for.

name: cite42_map_ai_prompts
